svg.title: The three gaps in an AI-native product operating model: signal, evidence, continuity
svg.desc: Three boxes in a row. Signal: does customer reality reach the decision. Evidence: can a new idea be compared with a roadmap bet. Continuity: does the reason for a bet survive every handoff. Each box carries a test to run this week.
